name: Two Weeks in Painland
source: Two Weeks in Painland is a story-driven game about a run-of-the-mill hacker spying on gangsters who are anything but, all while trying to keep his life and limbs in the process. Easier said than done.
translation: 《Painland两周》是一款故事驱动的游戏，讲述了一名普通黑客监视绝非黑帮的故事，同时在这个过程中试图保住自己的生命和四肢。说起来容易做起来难。
